Clinical calm, botanical clarity

Gentle, evidence-aware aromatherapy for everyday resilience

I combine clinical safety practices with plant science and client-centred ritual to craft personalised, practical aromatherapy plans. No promises of cures—only supportive sensory care.

{{PRIMARY_CTA_LABEL}} Learn offerings
  • Hybrid consultations (virtual + in-person)
  • Safety-forward guidance for home use
  • Patch tests & dilution plans provided

Quick intake

A brief intake helps tailor your blend. Share sensitivities, medications, and household considerations (pets, pregnancy, kids).

Practice grounded in safety

I am {{PRACTITIONER_NAME}}, an aromatherapy practitioner trained in chemistry-aware blending and risk mitigation. My approach emphasises clear guidance: dilution ratios, patch testing, and pet- and pregnancy-aware adaptations. Sessions are collaborative and educational—so you can integrate oils into daily life with confidence.

How a session works

  1. Intake & safety screen
  2. Personalised aroma profile & blend options
  3. Dilution plan, patch test instructions, and home application guidance

Hybrid model: remote follow-up available. Unknown or complex medical situations are handled with extra caution—no clinical claims are made.

Structured framework

A reproducible, safety-first framework for working with aromatic extracts.

Screen

Assess sensitivities, medications, pregnancy, and pets to identify contraindications.

Profile

Map top/middle/base notes and sensory language so clients can choose what resonates.

Formulate

Create blends with clear dilution guidelines and a suggested delivery method.

Verify

Patch test protocols and follow-up checks to ensure tolerability.

Offers
